info.name: Meditech Merchant API
info.description: Replacement Postman collection for the currently mounted merchant API surface. Start with Auth / Setup, then move through onboarding, catalog management, subscriptions, wallet, and drugstore operational flows. Internal drugstore requests are included in a dedicated signed folder.

item.name: Health

request.description: Check API and database status.

item.description: Health check endpoint for smoke validation and service monitoring.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Merchant authentication bootstrap. Use these requests to create a merchant, verify OTP, complete signup, log in, and capture access tokens for the rest of the collection.

request.description: Start signup flow. Returns OTP (visible in dev mode).
Verify OTP from signup. Use the OTP returned in dev mode.
Complete signup with business details. Creates merchant, wallet, and Free subscription.
Login and auto-save JWT token to collection variable. All other requests use this token automatically.

Exchange the current refresh token for a new access token.

Body fields:
- refreshToken: Refresh token returned from login or a previous refresh.

Start the merchant password-reset flow.

Body fields:
- email: Merchant email address to receive or generate the OTP.

Verify the OTP for password reset.

Body fields:
- email: Merchant email.
- otp: Reset OTP returned in development or sent by email.

Set a new merchant password after OTP verification.

Body fields:
- email: Merchant email.
- newPassword: New password.
- confirmPassword: Must match newPassword.

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: Merchant onboarding status checks, bank lookup, file-link submission, and bank-account verification.

request.description:
Return current merchant onboarding progress and completion status.

Consumption notes:
- Call this after login to know which onboarding step to show next.

List banks supported by the backend / Paystack bank-verification flow.

Consumption notes:
- Use the returned bank code when calling Verify Bank Account.

Submit the already-uploaded valid-ID file URL for onboarding.

Body fields:
- validIdUrl: Public or storage URL of the uploaded identity document.

Submit the already-uploaded profile image URL for onboarding.

Body fields:
- profilePictureUrl: URL of the merchant profile image.

Validate bank-account details before storing them.

Body fields:
- bankCode: Bank code from List Supported Banks.
- accountNumber: 10-digit account number.
- accountName: Expected account holder name.

item.name: Upload
item.description: General upload endpoints for merchant files. These endpoints return file metadata/URLs you can feed into onboarding, product, or settings flows.

request.description:
Upload one file to the general merchant upload service.

Form-data fields:
- file: Local file to upload. Accepted types include jpeg, jpg, png, pdf, and svg.

Upload up to 10 files in one request.

Form-data fields:
- files: Repeat the field for each file you want to upload.

item.name: Settings
item.description: Authenticated merchant settings endpoints. Use these to manage business profile, banking, store details, notification rules, and store preferences.

request.description:
Fetch the merchant's combined settings payload.

Consumption notes:
- Use this to hydrate the full settings screen in one request.

Patch profile, store, payment, notification, and preference fields in one request.

Body fields:
- Combines the fields from the profile, store, payment, notification, and preference endpoints.
- If you include payment fields, send bankCode, accountNumber, and accountName together.

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "Jane",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "phoneNumber": "08012345678",
  "phoneCountryCode": "+234",
  "businessName": "MiMeds Pharmacy",
  "businessAddress": "14 Haruna Ishola Street",
  "city": "Lagos",
  "state": "Lagos",
  "openHour": "08:00",
  "closeHour": "20:00",
  "storeDescription": "Neighborhood pharmacy and drugstore.",
  "bankCode": "{{merchant_bank_code}}",
  "accountNumber": "{{merchant_account_number}}",
  "accountName": "{{merchant_account_name}}",
  "pushNotificationsEnabled": true,
  "emailNotificationsEnabled": true,
  "storePreferences": {
    "acceptOrdersAutomatically": false,
    "requireManualApprovalForPrescriptions": true,
    "enableInHouseDelivery": true,
    "deliveryFeeType": "flat",
    "deliveryFlatFee": 700
  }
}

request.description:
Update the merchant user's personal profile fields.

Body fields:
- firstName, lastName, phoneNumber, phoneCountryCode.

Update bank-account payout settings.

Body fields:
- bankCode: Bank code from onboarding bank list.
- accountNumber: 10-digit bank account number.
- accountName: Account holder name.

Update business/storefront configuration.

Body fields:
- businessName, businessUrl, businessAddress, city, state, landmark.
- openHour / closeHour in HH:MM.
- vacation / vacationStartDate / vacationEndDate.
- storeDescription, storeBannerUrl.

body.raw:
{
  "businessName": "{{merchant_business_name}}",
  "businessUrl": "https://mimeds.example.com",
  "businessAddress": "14 Haruna Ishola Street",
  "city": "Lagos",
  "state": "Lagos",
  "landmark": "Near the junction",
  "openHour": "08:00",
  "closeHour": "20:00",
  "vacation": false,
  "storeDescription": "Neighborhood pharmacy and wellness store.",
  "storeBannerUrl": "https://example.com/banners/store-banner.png"
}

request.description:
Change the merchant password while authenticated.

Body fields:
- currentPassword: Existing password.
- newPassword: New password with uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.
- confirmPassword: Must match newPassword.

Update global notification toggles and per-event notification channels.

Body fields:
- pushNotificationsEnabled / emailNotificationsEnabled.
- notificationPreferences: orderPlaced, lowStock, payoutAlert, supportTicket channel toggles.

Update store-level operational preferences.

Body fields:
- storePreferences: automatic order handling, prescription approval rules, stock display, pickup/delivery, and delivery pricing controls.

body.raw:
{
  "storePreferences": {
    "acceptOrdersAutomatically": false,
    "requireManualApprovalForPrescriptions": true,
    "allowOutOfStockAlternatives": false,
    "autoHideOutOfStock": false,
    "enablePharmacyPickup": true,
    "enableInHouseDelivery": true,
    "deliveryRadius": 10,
    "deliveryFeeType": "flat",
    "deliveryFlatFee": 700,
    "deliveryStartTime": "09:00",
    "deliveryEndTime": "18:00",
    "lowStockThreshold": 5,
    "showLowStockLabel": true
  }
}

item.name: Products
item.description: Catalog management endpoints for merchant-owned products.

request.description: Return product-level summary statistics for the signed-in merchant.
List products currently at or below the configured low-stock threshold.

List all products owned by the signed-in merchant.

Consumption notes:
- Use this to populate the merchant product table/grid.

Create a catalog product.

Body fields:
- name, description, category, brand, sku.
- price, vat, discountPercentage.
- minQuantity, maxQuantity, inventory.
- images: 1-3 image objects with url, order, isMain.
- isActive.

Note:
- The current model also supports prescription-aware products. Add that from the admin flow if your backend exposes it in the request mapper.

Fetch one product by UUID.

Path params:
- productId: Product identifier from the list/create response.

Patch one or more editable product fields.

Path params:
- productId: Product identifier.

Body fields:
- Any subset of the create-product payload may be sent.

Set the current inventory value for a product.

Body fields:
- inventory: Non-negative integer stock count.

Soft-delete a product from the merchant catalog.

Path params:
- productId: Product identifier.

Restore a previously deleted product.

Path params:
- productId: Deleted product identifier.

item.name: Discounts
item.description: Discount and promotion management for merchant catalog offers.

request.description: List discounts created by the signed-in merchant.
Return summary metrics for merchant discounts and promotions.

Validate whether a discount code can be applied to the given order composition.

Body fields:
- code: Discount code.
- orderAmount: Current order subtotal.
- productIds or products: Array of product UUIDs.

Create a discount campaign.

Body fields:
- code, type, amount.
- applyToAllProducts or specific applicableProducts/applicableCategories.
- minOrderAmount, status, startDate, endDate.
- usageLimit, perUserLimit.

Fetch one discount by UUID.

Path params:
- discountId: Identifier from list/create responses.

Patch an existing discount.

Body fields:
- Send any subset of create-discount fields.
- If type is percentage, amount must not exceed 100.

Soft-delete a discount campaign.

Path params:
- discountId: Discount identifier.

Restore a previously deleted discount.

Path params:
- discountId: Deleted discount identifier.
List categories available to the signed-in merchant.

Create a category.

Body fields:
- name: Category display name.
- description: Optional category note.

Fetch one category by UUID.

Path params:
- categoryId: Identifier from list/create responses.

Patch category fields.

Body fields:
- name, description, isActive.

Soft-delete a category.

Path params:
- categoryId: Category identifier.

Restore a previously deleted category.

Path params:
- categoryId: Deleted category identifier.

Submit a support request from the merchant dashboard.

Body fields:
- subject: Short issue summary.
- message: Detailed support message.
- email / phoneNumber: Optional contact override fields if the support form allows them.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: Subscription management including plan discovery, subscription lifecycle actions, and Paystack-backed payment confirmation.

request.description:
Get all available subscription plans. No auth required.

Plan IDs are auto-saved to collection variables for use in other requests.

**Plans:**
- Free (₦0) — 10 products
- Bronze (₦2,500/mo) — 30 products
- Silver (₦5,000/mo) — 80 products
- Gold (₦10,000/mo) — unlimited
Get the current merchant's subscription details including plan info and any pending plan changes.

Subscribe to a paid plan from Free using wallet balance.

Make sure wallet has enough funds first (Fund Wallet → Confirm Funding).

exec: console.log('🔗 Open authorizationUrl in browser to pay: ' + res.data.authorizationUrl);

request.description:
Subscribe via Paystack card payment.

Returns an `authorizationUrl` — open in browser to complete payment.
Then call **Confirm Payment** with the reference.

Subscribe via Paystack bank transfer.

Returns an `authorizationUrl` — open in browser to complete payment.
Then call **Confirm Payment** with the reference.

Confirm a Paystack payment after card/bank_transfer.

Use the reference returned from the Subscribe or Upgrade request.

Upgrade to a higher plan. Charges the full new plan price.

New billing cycle starts immediately. Any pending downgrades are cancelled.

exec: console.log('✅ Reference saved. Open authorizationUrl in browser to pay.');

request.description: Upgrade via Paystack card. Open `authorizationUrl` in browser, then call **Confirm Payment**.

Schedule a downgrade to a lower plan.

**Deferred** — takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
No payment required. Your current plan stays active until then.
Cancel a previously scheduled downgrade. Your current plan continues as normal.

Cancel your subscription. Reverts to the Free plan at the end of the current billing period.

Auto-renewal is disabled. Current plan stays active until period end.
Enable auto-renewal. Plan renews automatically at billing period end.
Disable auto-renewal. Plan expires at the end of current billing period.

item.name: Wallet
item.description: Wallet balance, funding, and transaction-history flows.

request.description:
Get wallet balance. Amount is in kobo (÷100 for Naira).

`balanceInNaira` is provided for convenience.

Initialize wallet funding via Paystack.

**Amount is in Naira** (minimum ₦100).

Returns `authorizationUrl` — open in browser to pay with card or bank transfer.
Then call **Confirm Funding** with the reference.

Confirm wallet funding after completing Paystack payment.

Use the reference from the Fund Wallet response.

Get paginated transaction history.

**Optional filters** (as query params):
- `type`: `subscription_payment`, `wallet_funding`, `wallet_debit`, `refund`
- `status`: `pending`, `success`, `failed`
Get transactions filtered by type and status.

item.name: Drugstore Orders
item.description: Merchant-side drugstore operational endpoints used by the orders dashboard you showed.

request.description:
List drugstore orders for the signed-in merchant.

Query params:
- page / limit: Pagination.
- search: Search by order id or customer name.
- paymentStatus: pending | paid | failed.
- deliveryStatus: pending | picked_up | in_transit | delivered | cancelled.
- dateRange: today | yesterday | last_7_days | last_30_days.
- ageBucket: lt_24h | between_24h_48h | gt_48h.

Consumption notes:
- This is the main table-feed endpoint for the merchant orders screen.

Download the current filtered drugstore order list as CSV.

Consumption notes:
- This endpoint returns file content, not JSON.
- Reuse the same filters you apply in the orders table before export.

exec: pm.test("CSV export returned a file payload", function () {

request.description:
Update a merchant-side delivery status and trigger reverse sync back to experience_1.

Path params:
- orderId: Merchant-side drugstore order id.

Body fields:
- deliveryStatus: pending | picked_up | in_transit | delivered | cancelled.
- note: Optional timeline note or operational comment.

item.name: Drugstore Prescriptions
item.description: Merchant review queue for prescription-gated drugstore orders.

request.description:
List submitted prescriptions waiting for merchant action.

Query params:
- status: Optional workflow filter such as submitted, approved, rejected, or needs_clarification.

Approve, reject, or request clarification on a consumer prescription.

Path params:
- prescriptionId: Prescription identifier from the queue/list response.

Body fields:
- action: approved | rejected | needs_clarification.
- note: Optional merchant-facing explanation or instruction to the consumer.

item.name: Internal Drugstore
item.description: Signed internal endpoints consumed by experience_1. These are service-to-service routes and require HMAC headers; the folder pre-request script populates those automatically from environment variables.

request.description:
Service-to-service catalog listing used by experience_1 drugstore browsing.

Query params:
- merchantId: Merchant whose products should be exposed.
- page / limit / search / category / sortBy / sortDirection: Standard product list controls.

Service-to-service product detail lookup.

Path params:
- productId: Product UUID.

Query params:
- merchantId: Owning merchant id.
Service-to-service category listing for a pharmacy catalog.

Service-to-service pharmacy discovery endpoint consumed by experience_1.

Query params:
- search: Optional text filter.
- page / limit: Pagination.
- activeCartMerchantId / activeCartItemCount / activeCartSubtotal: Optional current cart context for compatibility hints.
Service-to-service pharmacy profile endpoint used by experience_1 profile/about screens.

Service-to-service pharmacy review feed.

Query params:
- page / limit: Pagination.

Service-to-service discount validation for experience_1 checkout flows.

Body fields:
- merchantId, code, orderAmount, productIds.

Reflect a paid experience_1 drugstore order into the merchant system.

Body fields:
- sourceOrderId: Original experience_1 order id.
- merchantId: Merchant that should receive the order.
- sourceUserId / sourceUserName: Consumer or doctor identity summary.
- totals: subtotal, discountAmount, deliveryFee, totalAmount.
- delivery: address snapshot plus deliveryDate and deliveryTimeSlot.
- items: Product snapshots and quantities.
